title: Gateway infrastructure-prefix error code registry
description: Formal schema for gateway/error-codes.json. Validates the DSL that gateway/error-codes.json must conform to. The registry itself is the single source of truth for GATEWAY_* / INTERNAL_* codes and is consumed by scripts/generate-error-code-registry.py (renders backend.md §6.3.1), scripts/check-contracts.py (cross-layer drift assertions), and gateway Lua plugins' init-time self-checks.

propertyNames.description: Keys MUST be SCREAMING_SNAKE_CASE infra-prefix error codes. Business-domain codes (ANALYSIS_*, ...) are explicitly disallowed here — they live in per-service OpenAPI details.errorCode enums.

httpStatus.description: The HTTP status emitted when this code fires. MUST equal the top-level `code` in the §6.0 envelope (backend.md §6.0).

category.description: The §6.3.2 second-tier dispatch category. Frontend falls back to this when errorCode is unknown.

writtenBy.description: Which component emits this code. Suggested formats: `gateway:<plugin-name>`, `business-service`, `business-service:<filter-name>`. Purely informational — not machine-checked.

trigger.description: Human-readable triggering condition, rendered into backend.md §6.3.1's `触发条件` column.

retryable.description: Whether a generic client-side retry has a chance of succeeding. Consumed by frontend `api_error` mapping and scripts/check-contracts.py cross-check with `category`.

retryGuidance.description: Optional machine-readable note on what a client SHOULD do before retrying. Only meaningful when `retryable` is true.

docAnchor.description: The authoritative documentation anchor (e.g. `gateway.md §5.1`). Rendered into the §6.3.1 `文档锚点` column verbatim.

allOf.description: retryGuidance MUST only be present when retryable is true. A guidance string on a non-retryable code is a contract smell — the client shouldn't be told `retry once` for a code that can never succeed on retry.
